sub_indicators.label: Power and water for data centres
sub_indicators.subject: infra.energy
sub_indicators.text: Sufficient energy and water for data centres: power and water for data centres
sub_indicators.norm_short: The Smart Africa Data Center and Cloud Blueprint asks that data centres run on dual grid feeds with backup generation and report their power usage effectiveness.
criteria: A source from the past three years says a data centre was stopped, delayed or rationed for want of power or water, or runs on diesel as its main supply.
A data centre in service has a secured power supply: two grid feeds, its own substation or line, or its own power plant.
Power is set aside for data centres: a signed supply contract, a plant built for them, or a tariff or zone in force.
A data centre in service states a power usage effectiveness (PUE) of 1.6 or less, from the past three years.
A data centre in service publishes its water use, or states that its cooling uses no water, from the past three years.

aspects.name: A secured supply in service, and power reserved for data centres
